$comment: Shared VfProgressSpinner cases. Plain data only. The vocabulary is the historical Vue contract at fd793696f50d3be0fcd3788f0f8f751c63869963. This catalog is the standalone public component's, not VfButton's: no case here is a loading button, and contracts/button/cases.json must never stand in for it - the button forwards one size, one stroke width and one class, and a catalog derived from it would measure exactly that subset and call it the spinner. Four dimensions are real: size (a number, zero, a fraction, a string, a token reference, an empty string), stroke width (default, thick, fractional, zero), tone (eight values, primary suppressed), and the consumer contract (class order, style merge, the custom property overridden, a role and a name replacing the component's own, aria-hidden, value semantics passed through, product data). Every case declares zero component-owned controls and no consumer control, because the spinner has no slot: nothing a consumer writes can reach the DOM through it.

propVocabulary.label: string, default "Loading". Written verbatim as aria-label on the root; an empty string is written empty, not dropped.
propVocabulary.size: string | number, default undefined. Written as the --vf-progress-spinner-size custom property: a number becomes pixels, a string passes through, absent writes nothing so the theme token applies, and an empty string writes no declaration either.
propVocabulary.strokeWidth: number, default 4. Written as stroke-width on both circles, the track and the value arc.
propVocabulary.tone: One of neutral | primary | success | info | warn | help | danger | contrast, default primary. Selects the root modifier (none at primary, one for every other value including neutral). Never changes the role.

cases.title: A bare spinner: the theme token sizes it, the primary colour paints the arc, the default stroke of 4, named Loading
A numeric size, written as pixels into the custom property
A zero size, which is a length rather than an absence: the box collapses and the artwork with it
A string size, passed through verbatim as a length
A token reference as the size - the form VfButton forwards - resolved by the stylesheet, not the component
A fractional numeric size, which keeps its decimals on the way to pixels
An empty-string size, which writes no declaration and sizes exactly like the default
A thick stroke on both circles, the track included
A fractional stroke width, written as-is
A zero stroke width: both circles are present and nothing is drawn
The neutral tone: a modifier the stylesheet paints with the secondary icon colour
The primary tone named explicitly, which emits no modifier and renders exactly like the default
The success tone
The info tone
The warn tone
The help tone
The danger tone
The contrast tone, painted with the primary icon colour
A custom accessible name
An empty accessible name: the attribute is present and empty, not absent
A consumer class, appended after the block class
A consumer class after a tone modifier, so the order of all three is measured
A consumer style beside no size declaration of the component's own
A consumer style merged after the component's size declaration
A consumer declaration of the size property, which wins over the prop
A consumer role, which replaces progressbar rather than sitting beside it
A consumer aria-label, which replaces the label prop's name
A consumer aria-hidden on the root: the spinner leaves the tree while keeping its role attribute
Consumer value attributes forwarded onto the progressbar, which the component neither writes nor rejects
A product data attribute and an id, forwarded onto the root and never onto the svg
Everything at once: a large danger spinner with a thick stroke, a consumer class, style and name
